personal.name: Muhammad Fahmi Al
personal.title: Mechanical Engineer | Researcher | Problem Solver | Leader
personal.about:
I am a final-year Mechanical Engineering student at Universitas Diponegoro, specializing in fluid mechanics, computational fluid dynamics (CFD), and energy conversion systems. With a GPA of 3.64/4.00 and hands-on research experience at the Mechanical Fluid and Thermal Research Lab, I bridge rigorous analytical thinking with real-world engineering execution.

Beyond technical mastery, I have led large-scale national events, managed cross-functional teams of 100+ members, and driven measurable outcomes through structured project management frameworks. As Executive Director of INCEPTION 2025 — the biggest petroleum event at Undip — I secured 90+ competing teams from across Indonesia and grew an audience of 154,000. I do not just solve problems — I architect solutions.

research.title: Mechanical Fluid and Thermal Research Lab
research.description:
Conducting advanced research in fluid mechanics and thermal systems using industry-grade simulation tools. Working on cutting-edge projects involving computational fluid dynamics (CFD) with ANSYS Fluent and Discrete Element Method (DEM) simulations with ESSS Rocky.

Responsibilities include setting up simulation models, running parametric studies, validating computational results against experimental data, and contributing to research reports and documentation. This lab experience directly shapes my ability to apply theoretical engineering principles to complex, real-world problems.

hard.title: Computer Aided Design ( Certified as SOLIDWORKS CAD Design Associate)
hard.description: Proficient in 2D and 3D engineering design using AutoCAD and SOLIDWORKS. Certified as SOLIDWORKS CAD Design Associate (CSWA) in 2025. Applied in professional internship work designing heat exchanger components to TEMA and ASME standards.

hard.title: Computational Fluid Dynamics
hard.description: Experienced in simulating complex fluid flow and heat transfer phenomena using ANSYS Fluent. Applied in research projects at the MFT Research Lab for thermal analysis, turbulence modeling, and experimental validation of theoretical fluid dynamic models.

hard.title: Discrete Element Method
hard.description: Skilled in particle-based simulation using ESSS Rocky DEM software. Applied in research to model granular flow behavior and particle-fluid interactions — enabling deeper understanding of complex multiphase systems in mechanical engineering applications.

hard.title: Technomatic Plant Simulation
hard.description: Capable of modeling and simulating manufacturing and industrial plant systems to analyze throughput, bottlenecks, and process efficiency. Supports data-driven decision making for plant layout optimization and production planning.

soft.description: Adept at structured project management using OKR and KPI frameworks. Managed organizational programs for 100+ staff members at HMM Undip, ensuring all targets were met systematically — bringing engineering-grade precision to organizational work.

soft.title: Team Work
soft.description: Experienced in building and sustaining high-performance collaborative teams across diverse disciplines. Participated in the SPE eMentoring program and led cross-functional teams in both academic research and national competitions.

projects.title: Offshore Wind Farm Development Potential Study
projects.headline: Assessing Rote Island's offshore wind energy potential in collaboration with PLN
projects.description:
A collaborative research study with PLN (Indonesia's state electricity company) evaluating the offshore wind farm development potential at Rote Island, Indonesia. The study analyzed wind resource data, site conditions, bathymetry, and projected energy output to support Indonesia's ambitious renewable energy transition goals — contributing to the national effort to increase the share of renewables in the energy mix.

projects.headline: 2nd Runner Up national geothermal engineering competition
projects.description: Developed a comprehensive geothermal energy development proposal as team leader for IPFest 2024. The study covered full-cycle resource assessment, well design, surface facility layout, and economic feasibility analysis. Achieved 2nd Runner Up position among engineering teams from universities across Indonesia — demonstrating both technical depth in renewable energy and strategic engineering problem-solving.

projects.headline: Finalist in national geothermal engineering case competition
projects.description: Reached the Finalist stage in the Derrick 2024 Geothermal Case Competition. Led the team in developing a detailed geothermal energy exploitation strategy, integrating technical engineering analysis with comprehensive environmental impact assessment and economic considerations.

projects.title: Shell and Tube Heat Exchanger Design
projects.headline: Industrial heat exchanger design and optimization at PT. Rekayasa Industri
projects.description: Designed and optimized shell and tube heat exchangers during internship at PT. Rekayasa Industri. Utilized AutoCAD for detailed component drafting and HTRI software for thermal-hydraulic design and optimization. All designs were rigorously validated against TEMA (Tubular Exchanger Manufacturers Association) and ASME (American Society of Mechanical Engineers) international standards — ensuring both performance and compliance with client requirements.
